description: This source file defines the DatabaseShellsSettingsSources class, which implements IShellsSettingsSources to manage shell settings stored in a database for OrchardCore. It includes methods for adding, saving, removing, and migrating shell settings, utilizing dependency injection, async database operations, and JSON handling.

classes.name: DatabaseShellsSettingsSources
classes.description: Implements IShellsSettingsSources to manage shell settings stored in a database, with methods for adding, saving, removing, and migrating settings.

methods.name: DatabaseShellsSettingsSources
methods.description: Constructor initializing configuration, context factory, and tenant path.

methods.name: AddSourcesAsync
methods.description: Adds all shell settings to configuration builder from database.

methods.name: AddSourcesAsync (overload)
methods.description: Adds specific tenant shell settings to configuration builder.

methods.name: SaveAsync
methods.description: Saves or updates shell settings for a tenant in the database.

methods.name: RemoveAsync
methods.description: Removes a tenant’s shell settings from the database.

methods.name: GetDocumentAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the shell settings document from the database, migrating from file if necessary.

methods.name: TryMigrateFromFileAsync
methods.description: Attempts to migrate shell settings from a file if database entry does not exist.
